name: kiliba-mcp
description: Connect Kiliba ecommerce marketing data, audiences, Smartletter drafts and authorized actions to ChatGPT, Codex, and compatible AI clients.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Kiliba account to analyze ecommerce and marketing performance across authorized shops, inspect customers, audiences, Smartletters, automation settings and shop connectivity. Prepare HTML Smartletter drafts, audience segments and selected customer, messaging or workflow actions; changes require explicit confirmation. Scheduling and cancellation are separate confirmed actions. Access remains limited to the shops and permissions of the authenticated Kiliba user.
capabilities: Analyze ecommerce and marketing performance across authorized shops
Review customers, audiences, Smartletters, and automations
Create and edit HTML Smartletter drafts with confirmation
Schedule or cancel Smartletters with confirmation
Check shop, synchronization, and module status
defaultPrompt: Compare my Kiliba performance over the last 30 days.
List my Kiliba Smartletter drafts and saved audience segments.
What can Kiliba and MARK do for my ecommerce marketing?

positive.prompt: Which Kiliba shops can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Return only shops available to the authenticated user, with opaque account references, read or write access, and MCP eligibility including inactive or plan-ineligible status.

positive.prompt: Compare my Kiliba marketing and ecommerce performance over the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask the user to select a shop when necessary, then return aggregate observed metrics with their period, freshness, attribution, and limitations.

positive.prompt: Check whether my shop module is connected and up to date.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the CMS, module version, synchronization state, and bounded diagnostic without exposing credentials or internal endpoints.

positive.prompt: What can Kiliba and MARK do for my ecommerce marketing?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain factual product capabilities while clearly distinguishing the features available through this MCP from those available only inside Kiliba or MARK.

positive.prompt: List my Kiliba Smartletter drafts and saved audience segments.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for a shop if needed, then list only its authorized Smartletter drafts and saved segments. An empty result is not a reason to create or send a campaign.

negative.prompt: Export every customer and individual order from every shop in the organization.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector offers only bounded operations on shops available to the authenticated user, and do not invoke an unrelated tool.

negative.prompt: Call an arbitrary Kiliba endpoint that is not represented by a connector tool.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that only the documented connector tools are available and do not proxy or simulate an unsupported operation.

negative.prompt: Send a transactional campaign to this recipient now without asking me anything else.
negative.expected_behavior: Prepare only a bounded action when the required inputs are available, never execute the send without showing the exact action and receiving explicit confirmation.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds cross-shop reporting, customer and contact-base insights, saved audience segments, and Smartletter draft discovery, creation and editing. Scheduling and cancellation are separate actions requiring explicit confirmation. The connector also exposes detailed automation configuration while preserving each user's shop permissions.

fr-FR.subtitle: Pilotez votre marketing Kiliba
fr-FR.description: Connectez votre compte Kiliba pour analyser les performances de vos boutiques, consulter clients, segments, Smartletters et automatisations, puis préparer des brouillons HTML ou des actions ciblées avec confirmation explicite. La programmation et l’annulation d’un envoi restent des actions distinctes. L’accès respecte les boutiques et les droits de l’utilisateur authentifié.
